note: Only removes the legendInteractive prop from a chart in the file; the summary cards are not unified into one component.
Moves rollout_state_and_variant into FeatureFlagStatusChecker as a method using self, dropping the checker parameter and forward-reference string.
Renames the viewset to SignalProcessingViewSet and adds a top-level list GET returning paused_until, replacing the state action; pause/unpause become PUT/DELETE.
Removes the duplicate TextChoices classes and derives choice lists from the Literal types via get_args; keeps the Literal rather than removing it.
Removes the separate debug-symbols command and exposes native ELF upload as an Upload subcommand of symbol-sets.
Replaces the FeatureFlag string literals with ScheduledChange.AllowedModels.FEATURE_FLAG in the exclude and model-name checks.
Renames lanes to pipelines and moves the ingestionwarnings pipeline directory and its tests to clientwarnings.
Adds a wait_for_restrictions_loaded helper and stores the restriction service on ServerHandle; the duplicated message helpers are untouched.
Drops the length*2.5 heuristic, now using the measured width when positive and the length*7 fallback otherwise; no named constants added.
Replaces the hardcoded 400/memory-code check with the shared extractValidationError helper, so 512 details surface; also tweaks retry rules.
